case_name: Shri Sukanta Shil vs The Union Of India

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Shri Sukanta Shil, son of Sri Jogesh Chandra Shil
parties.respondent_defendant: The Union of India, represented by the Secretary, Ministry of Communication, and others

facts_of_case: Petitioner has challenged an order issued by respondent No.2 whereby Post Master Agartala, HPO was directed to comply with judgments dated 17.03.2006 and 12.03.2012.

legal_principles.principle: A party who fails to comply with a court's direction may be required to pay maintenance allowance.
legal_principles.held: If the respondent fails to comply with the direction of the Court, he has to pay at the rate of Rs.4,000/- per month to the petitioner and their daughter as maintenance allowance.

legal_principles.principle: A court may request a third party to deduct maintenance allowance from the pay and allowances of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: The Director of Postal Service is hereby requested to direct the Drawing and Disbursing Officer of the respondent to deduct at the rate of Rs.4,000/- per month from the pay and allowances of the respondent and to send the same to the petitioner in her below noted address by money order within the first week of every English Calendar month.

outcome.final_order: The petitioner's prayer has been rejected.
